info.title: Simple Agent Tracer
info.description: Local mode permits unauthenticated query, owner actions and default-project ingestion on a loopback listener. Authenticated deployments use project-scoped bearer credentials or an OIDC administrator session. Administrator writes use same-origin verification. Credentials carry either read or ingest access.

429.description: Receiver busy. Retry-After is provided. Body is a binary google.rpc.Status.

503.description: Temporary database failure. Retry-After is provided. Body is a binary google.rpc.Status.
